parameters.query:
SELECT config_key, config_value
FROM workflow_config
WHERE config_key IN (
  'selected_dev_server_name',
  'selected_prod_server_name',
  'selected_dev_database_name',
  'selected_prod_database_name'
);

SELECT
    sch.name AS SCHEMA_NAME,
    p.name AS ROUTINE_NAME,
    mod.definition AS DEFINITION
FROM
    sys.procedures AS p
INNER JOIN
    sys.sql_modules AS mod ON mod.object_id = p.object_id
INNER JOIN
    sys.schemas AS sch ON sch.schema_id = p.schema_id
WHERE
    p.is_ms_shipped = 0 -- Excludes system procedures
ORDER BY
    sch.name, p.name;

-- 1. Get the selected DB names from the config node
DECLARE @DevDB NVARCHAR(255) = '{{ $items("Get Config DBs").find(item => item.json.config_key === 'selected_dev_database_name').json.config_value }}';
DECLARE @ProdDB NVARCHAR(255) = '{{ $items("Get Config DBs").find(item => item.json.config_key === 'selected_prod_database_name').json.config_value }}';

-- 2. Merge the NEW list of changes
MERGE procedure_approvals AS target
USING (SELECT
  @DevDB AS dev_database,
  @ProdDB AS prod_database,
  '{{ $json.procedure_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS procedure_name,
  '{{ $json.change_type.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS change_type,
  '{{ $json.changes_only.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS changes_only,
  '{{ $json.dev_DEFINITION.replace(/'/g, "''") }}' AS dev_definition
) AS source
-- 3. Match on all three parts of the composite key
ON (target.procedure_name = source.procedure_name 
    AND target.dev_database = source.dev_database 
    AND target.prod_database = source.prod_database)
-- If a match is found (it's an existing procedure for this DB pair)
WHEN MATCHED THEN
  UPDATE SET
    change_type = source.change_type,
    changes_only = source.changes_only,
    dev_definition = source.dev_definition,
    status = 'pending'
-- If it's a new procedure for this DB pair
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
  INSERT (dev_database, prod_database, procedure_name, change_type, changes_only, dev_definition, status)
  VALUES (source.dev_database, source.prod_database, source.procedure_name, source.change_type, source.changes_only, source.dev_definition, 'pending');

SELECT
    sch.name AS SCHEMA_NAME,
    p.name AS ROUTINE_NAME,
    mod.definition AS DEFINITION
FROM
    sys.procedures AS p
INNER JOIN
    sys.sql_modules AS mod ON mod.object_id = p.object_id
INNER JOIN
    sys.schemas AS sch ON sch.schema_id = p.schema_id
WHERE
    p.is_ms_shipped = 0 -- Excludes system procedures
ORDER BY
    sch.name, p.name;

    sch.name AS SCHEMA_NAME,
    p.name AS ROUTINE_NAME,
    mod.definition AS DEFINITION
FROM
    sys.procedures AS p
INNER JOIN
    sys.sql_modules AS mod ON mod.object_id = p.object_id
INNER JOIN
    sys.schemas AS sch ON sch.schema_id = p.schema_id
WHERE
    p.is_ms_shipped = 0 -- Excludes system procedures
ORDER BY
    sch.name, p.name;
